narrationTexts: I'll start by looking at the codebase.
finalText:
**Big, and it has four hard no-rename zones.** Scope is `1291` hits in `94` files, all snake_case, no `accountId` anywhere.

| Zone | Hits | Verdict |
|---|---|---|
| `services/*` JS locals and params | ~1053 | Safe |
| SQL text in `services/*/src/repo/*.js` | 125 | Freeze, no migration renames the column |
| `migrations/*.sql` | 61 | Freeze, applied history |
| `vendor/reporting-sdk` | 20 | Freeze, regenerated, unused |
| `docs/openapi.yaml` | 5 | Freeze, public contract |

Two more traps. All 25 repos write `account_id` into the `payload` JSONB. And [lib/serialize.js:8](lib/serialize.js:8) `WIRE` needs both sides kept.

[lib/audit.js:8](lib/audit.js:8) reads `fields.account_id` by name across 75 call sites. Rename it half way and audit logs go null with no error.

Next: ask them to split the PR at the repo boundary.
